source_selection: Current primary method and executable controlled benchmark, with supplementary analysis and dataset tools.

anonymization.credentials: Original values removed; replacement profiles use environment variables.
anonymization.identities: Known author, email, repository owner, Git identities and personal path tokens removed.
anonymization.naming: Lowercase snake_case with conventional repository metadata and Python package filenames.
anonymization.comments: Python comments and docstrings, PowerShell comments and shell comments removed.

syntax: All included Python modules parse successfully.

known_private_value_scan.scope: Known original credentials, private endpoints, repository owner, author and Git identity tokens; personal paths, nonanonymous emails, private keys and GitHub token patterns.

method_freeze.scope: Repackaged anonymous release, distinct from historical run hashes.

excluded: Real API credentials and private endpoint addresses
Raw human conversation trajectories and downloaded third-party source repositories
Manuscript and presentation sources or binaries
Unrelated personal workbooks and temporary host execution logs
limitations: Historical outcomes use their recorded implementation; the revised baseline has not been rerun to establish empirical model performance.
Fake-mode checks validate scripted behavior; they do not establish empirical model performance.
Content scans cannot verify the identity exposure of a future hosting account or commit author.
See artifact_coverage.json for exact evidence coverage and version limits.
